newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: There was good demand for various categories of tea at this week's Calcutta tea auction, traders said on Friday.
In all 85,334 packages, including 7,147 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
In CTC variety, clean well made Dooars and better liquoring Assams were firm. Major blends were active, traders said.
In Orthodox variety, clean whole leaf and larger brokens were also firm.
In Dust category, good liquoring and clean black sorts witnessed good demand, traders said.
